title: Agent Continuations for Resumable AI Workflows
exception_reason: Outside the primary window but retained for explicit continuation snapshot and resume mechanics in agent workflows.
relevance_note: SnapLogic blog on agent continuations (snapshot/resume state)
reason_included: Captures agent state in continuations (event log, pending actions) enabling pause and resume with no loss.

claim_snippets.claim_text: Agent Continuations snapshot the full state of an agent (including pending tool calls and nested sub-agents) at any step and can later resume the agent exactly where it left off.
After human approval, the updated continuation is returned and the agent reconstructs its entire workflow from it, resuming execution with no lost progress.
Every agent interaction (LLM call, tool execution) is recorded in a structured 'messages' event log; a continuation holds this array plus metadata about pending actions and approval flags.
